messages:
Raj (Sales): FYI FinServ sent MSA + DPA back. Main asks: Net45 payment, change to deletion clause, SLA 99.99 with penalty, and they want PO to start POC. Need legal + finance review. Link: https://internal/files/finserv-msadpa.pdf :eyes:
Tom (Legal): Got it. I'll triage. Quick thoughts: Net45 is non-standard for us (we default to Net30). SLA penalty — we prefer service credits capped to invoice. DPA edits likely ok with a few carveouts. Will draft a counter.
Aisha (AM): Who's the signer on their side? They said procurement will send PO, but need e-sign route. Also, is POC going on Hosted or Dedicated? That changes order form and price.
Claire (RevOps): Net45 needs finance approval. We can accept on an account-by-account basis with credit check or prepay. DocuSign is fine, but must use the legal-approved order form template.
Kevin (SE): For the POC we can do a 2-week dedicated sandbox (DED-POC-2W). If they require data residency in EU, that affects provisioning lead time. Pricing note: POC discount typically 50% for evaluation period.
Tom (Legal): Draft SLA counter (placeholder):
```
Service Level: 99.95% monthly uptime.
Service Credits: 5% credit of monthly charges for uptime < 99.95%, additional credits at thresholds, cumulative cap 50% of monthly invoice.
Exclusions: scheduled maintenance, force majeure, customer-caused outages.
```
Tom (Legal): Also flag: customer requested removal of our "no reverse engineering" IP protection. That is a redline; we need to keep an IP carveout for model weights.
Maya (Legal-bot): Checklist created: MSA redlines tracked -> https://git.internal/legal/finserv-msarules, DPA comments -> https://git.internal/legal/finserv-dpa, security questionnaire outstanding (sent to customer 2h ago).
Aisha (AM): FinServ signer = procurement director amy@finserv.com per call. I'll add them to DocuSign envelope once we have counters.
Claire (RevOps): Action items for finance: if we accept Net45, require PO + signed MSA + credit approval before granting dedicated capacity. @finance please advise.
Kevin (SE): If legal insists on keeping model IP clause, we can add a specific product-level carveout: "customer may not train against or extract model weights; allowed: API use for inference and logging."
Tom (Legal): I'll push the counter with the SLA and IP carveout, and mark Net45 as conditional on credit terms. Target: EOD tomorrow for draft.
Raj (Sales): Perfect — please cc me and Aisha on the DocuSign flow. Also they asked about SLA credits payment timing (apply to invoice).
Claire (RevOps): Noted. Credits are applied to next invoice unless it's the final invoice then it's refunded.
Aisha (AM): I'll confirm procurement contact details and route. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Kevin (SE): One more note for presales: we should confirm whether telemetry/logs are allowed to be retained by us for performance tuning (they flagged data deletion).
Tom (Legal): We'll allow operational logs with pseudonymization; will reflect in DPA counter.
Raj (Sales): Great. I'll update the customer with expected timeline: legal counter tomorrow, DocuSign once counters done, provisioning after PO/credit.
Maya (Legal-bot): Reminder: attach change log to the MSA PDF and use CLA tag `msarev-2026-03` when uploading.
Aisha (AM): I'll handle the esign envelope routing and follow up with procurement.
Claire (RevOps): Finance asked for invoicing contact and billing address — @Aisha pls get that in thread.
Raj (Sales): Will do. Thanks team, keeping this open until counters signed. :white_check_mark:
